game_title: Stack Of Plates – Moss Library Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library, a ruined library: the tomb cartographer must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library: a ruined library
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Library, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about stack_balance to power up the tomb cartographer and open the relic vault.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed statues in Moss Library.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
